name: Larry Block
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: He owns BlockParty WeHo and publishes WEHOonline. His campaign says he chaired the city's Public Facilities and Infrastructure Commission and the Disability Advisory Board. His campaign says his proposal allowing seniors and disabled renters to move to a first-floor unit without a rent increase became state law in 2023.

His campaign says he chaired the city's Public Facilities and Infrastructure Commission and the Disability Advisory Board.

items.text: He says public safety is his top priority and wants to spend 25% of the budget surplus on foot patrols. He opposes the city's Flock Safety camera contract, preferring a system the city controls. In 2024, he criticized city employment ordinances as hurting small businesses. In 2024, he opposed Proposition 33, a measure to expand local rent control. He favors a special election to fill a City Council vacancy.
